data.name: Jugesh
data.gender_notes: Jugesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jugesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jug' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ish' meaning 'of the Universe'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Jupiters, who represents strength, power, and prosperity. The name Jugesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jugesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jugesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jugesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jugesh holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism, where Jupiters is considered one of the navagrahas or nine planets that govern different aspects of human life. Navagrahas are believed to influence human life, and honoring them brings blessings and good fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Jugesh signifies an individual's connection to the divine and universal power symbolized by Jupiters. It represents strength, power, prosperity, and the belief that even in the face of struggles and challenges, one can find guidance and support from the divine. The name Jugesh is a reminder that ultimately, we are all under the protection and care of the Universe.
